nom: Bubble Cosmic Silk Hydrating Milky Toner

avis.texte: I absolutely love this toner. Gives me a beautiful glow. I love the price point as well and it lasts a long time.

I'm just starting to find things that work for my skin. I think this is one that is helping me get rid of my redness. A lot of people talk about the packaging. It does shoot out if you don't know how to close it properly. I found that shaking the bottle side to side before closing it fixes the problem!
I like the product. But why does it spurt out like a you know what everytime twist the top closed?

Beautiful formula, works great for my skin. But like many people said the packaging is awful. Even if you wait after using, it makes a mess any time you close the pop up mechanism. Literally shoots like a geyser. For how little product you receive in the bottle, its egregious.
I didnt think I needed this but wanted to try it out because an influencer raves about it. I bought this and it transformed my skin. My skin feels hydrated and plump. Got rid of my dry patches.

I was using the thayers milky toner and i didnt like that it foamed when you rubbed it in. So instopped using it And got this instead , a little under a month and im almost done with a bottle i love this product.
I have super sensitive skin and this product did not irritate it at all! It's insanely hydrating and my skin feels so soft after two uses.

avis.titre: not a replacement for glazing milk
avis.texte: i really wanted to love this product, but after 7 days of daily use, i am experiencing the worst breakout ive had in over a year. i am sad because my skin barrier was in perfect condition until i introduced this product into my routine. i am real bummed about how this affected my skin especially with how much it is hyped as a replacement for the glazing milk. it absolutely is not. pro tip - wait 15 (FIFTEEN) second before closing the lid to avoid the product shooting out everywhere/wasting the product.

I saw the reviews too late after purchasing the product. The toner is light weight, hydrating, and leaves a nice glowy finish but the packaging is horrible. When you twist to close it, it shoots out so much product that could've been enough for two or three separate uses. So much product is wasted I wish they would fix it.
It's so wonderful and hydrating. I love it so much but it broke me out so bad and I'm so mad that it did that to me
Each one better than the previous one, these products are wonderful, their ingredients are soft and not aggressive with the skin.
It's very good. It can be used on your make-uper, and the usual as a toner. Its spray shape is the best and its milky texture even better

avis.titre: Love it but container shape INCONVENIENT
avis.texte: I do enjoy how this feels on my skin. I will say, however, whoever designed this bottle needs to be publicly burnt at the stake! It's insanely inconvenient to twist to close and sometimes it squirts everywhere!

I use this in the morning, a very soft, hydrating product. The problem, like other user have stated, is the packaging. Every time I close it, a ton of product shoots out, very wasteful. I would definitely buy again if they redesign the bottle, until then probably not.

The product itself is great; however, the packaging is atrocious! So much of the product gets wasted when attempting to close the dispenser. Because of that, this might be a one and done purchase for me.
I do like the toner.. with that said the packing is the worst and you lose half the product every time you twist the lid closed…It shoots out as you close it. Wasteful.

Toner is SO hydrating and has a really pleasant texture, but the packaging is as bad as everyone says. It's hard to control how much product comes out and it drips all over the top of the packaging. It feels wasteful because so much comes out I usually have to wipe on my arms or wash off. I'm only tempted to rebuy because the product itself is actually really great for my eczema-prone skin...

I picked this up to add to several other moisturizing toners I have as part of my flooding routine. I absolutely love the silky milk texture of this. It absorbs quickly into my skin and doesn't leave me feeling sticky. I've seen a lot of complaints about the packaging of the bottle— there's definitely a trick to using it. Twist open the lid and shake the product into your hand, then wipe any excess off the lid and set it on the counter while you apply to your face. When you twist it closed after applying it, any excess product in the lid will have run back down into the bottle and nothing will squirt out of the top when you close it. Hope this helps!
I don't know if it's just the one I got but it explodes every time I try to close it. I love the product but because of the packaging I gave it 3 stars. So much waste.

avis.titre: Love the product, hate the bottle
avis.texte: This is my first time using a milky moisturizer and it's wonderful to use prior to putting my makeup on. Especially for the price given the comparable brands are triple what this costs. However, the reason for only 4 stars is because of the bottle/top. 70% of the time that I close it, it squirts out product which is causing waste or excess. That is my only gripe and I hope they find a solution.

My apologies that I do not have a before and after, but my facial routine with this added toner helped fade an acne dark spot. Now granted this spot was only about two weeks old, I believe the toner still helped. I gave it four stars because there is a older dark spot that has not cleared yet.

avis.titre: Love the product, hate the packaging
avis.texte: This milky toner works so well for my super sensitive red and irritated skin; however, every time you close the bottle after using the toner squirts out everywhere.

Holy wow- i went back and forth between thayers, bubble, ans byoma. I chose this one because i have reallly dry skin and honestly this has made more of a difference than any product ive ever tried. My skin drinks this stuff up and has felt amazing. New holy grail!!!

The tomer itself is so good. It makes your face feel hydrated and nakes it look super radiant. The packaginh though is terrible. When you shake some out it is fine but when you close it the bottle squirts out a ton more.

The formula is nice and hydrating and doesnt break me out like some other milky toners do. However, absolutely cant handle the packaging. No matter how you try to close it product will go everywhere. Its a nice fornual but cant justify repurchasing in that container.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: This is my second bottle and I love it so much I wish they would change the packaging because it leaks when you close it but I'm obsessed

this is the best milky toner I have ever tried that leaves my skin glowing all day and it looks so much younger I am hooked and the fact that it's cruelty free and vegan is a plus I have over 55 skin and it works amazing!

I have only been using this for four days. I love how smooth & silky it feels on my skin! I gave 4 stars because of the applicator. Just when you get a small size on you hand & try to close the applicator more product comes out everywhere. Very wasteful! Not sure I'll buy this brand again, it's frustrating.

This product was okay i loved the texture and have been wanting it for about 3 months i got it for my birthday and within 4 days of using it it broke me out my skin hasn't been bad since i added it to my skin care routine i have used it the right way just dosent work for me everything else from bubble is amazing just this isnt for me personally

I usually don't write reviews, but oh my God this product was amazing. It literally transformed my skin. I used rhode and it broke me out, and thayers was good bit too thin. I love how thick it is, but not too oily either. it sits amazing under makeup and now when i dont wear makeup it changed my skin from dry and dull to hydrated and glowy!! Definitely gonna keep re buying, this is now a staple for me.

Overall, I think it's a great product and very reasonably priced. However. I won't purchase again because of the packaging; When you close the top, product shoots out of the top. Sometimes a little, sometiems a lot (more than the amount on the face already) and is wasted although I do rub into my hands.
The cosmic silk milky toner feels like ACTUAL SILK on my face! It doesn't make my face get all red eaither!

I was skeptical about this toner but was influenced by Miss Shelby Ann and its become a favorite! Its light-weight, feels like a moisturizer and i love the packagaing of it! Highly recommend if you're looking for a moisturizing toner!

avis.titre: I wish I could love this but…
avis.texte: This toner does an amazing job at moisturizing; you can feel your skin being hydrated and it leaves a lovely, glowy finish once fully soaked in. However, the ingredients, specifically the heavy concentration of Coconut Alkanes caused me to break out, and pretty badly, too, might I add. Ended up giving it to a friend who is not acne-prone and she loves it! Just not for me. All my acne girlies and guys, you can skip this one.

I am 38 and this toner has done wonders for my skin. Really hydrates the skin and is a must in my skin prep prior to makeup. The way this has made a difference in my fine lines due to its hydration has me reaching for this once if not twice a day. I will be repurchasing.
I love how it feels on my skin! would TOTALLY recommend to people with sensitive skin!!

I recently tried this toner and two other Bubble products expecting they would add much needed moisture to my very dry skin. 2 weeks of daily use and my face has never felt worse; stripped completely of any moisture and feels like sand paper.
This is a great formula. Great way to add extra hydration into your skincare routine. The lid is designed terribly and causes product waste.

My skin is on the more oily side, and this pairs wonderfully with my moisturizer! For those that struggle with the product squirting out when you close it, I suggest twisting the cap slowly! It no longer leaks 🥰

avis.titre: Love the product hate the packaging
avis.texte: I love this formula, it's a great alternative for the Rhode glazing milk. But, I HATE the packaging. The top is terrible, I always end up getting way more product than I need to put because of that stupid lid. If you can get past that it's a great product. Like previously stated I love the formula
my fav milky toner ever! this is a must have in my skincare rountine! wears amazing under anything honestly
My dry skin loves this toner but i hate the packaging. The product spurts out every time i try to close it. It also does have a slight smell but that doesnt bother me too much.

I will use it again. I love it. It was so good in my skin cause I have sensitive skin. I always get pimples with any products, but with this one I didn't get no pimples. My face feels super good glowing
Made me break out so much, while it can make ur skin softer, you get so much more acne.

avis.titre: Product is great, packaging is awful
avis.texte: I am 50/50 on this product. The formula is beautiful, but the packaging ruins it for me. The formula is the perfect consistency for my dry skin in the cold weather and it feels amazing on the skin. The packing is a big no. The first thing is the smell. The product smells like the plastic container A LOT…like, bad. 99% of the time I am not sensitive to a products scent, but this is enough to bother me. The dispenser is also…questionable (IYKYK). You open it to dispense, and when you close it the product shoots up out of the hole and goes everywhere! I have been using this 2x day for about a week now, and the dispenser is already broken. I cannot open the dispenser at all, I have to unscrew the entire lid and it pours out super fast. Didn't drop it or otherwise break it at all. I am hoping I'm happier with it if I can move it to a different packaging. The formula itself is repurchase worthy…just not the packaging.
I love the stoner. It's one of the patrons that I have been repurchasing it again and again.the ingredients is very incredible affected. Also after applying get this, my skin feels very hydrated.

fix the bottle! when you twist to close it it spurts out product and gets everywhere. its finnicky. i have to tap bottom of the bottle on my hand or counter to clear the air out of it. other than that no complaints! great product! feels amazing and i notice a difference for sure.

I went to my friends house and tried this toner on one side of my face and the rhode toner on the other… YALL ITS THE SAME ITS A GOOD DUPE. Its so glowy and gives that glazed finish! If you care for the aesthetic go for rhode. If you want the same effect or glow, go for this.
I've tried other milky toners and have had some bad reactions but this one doesn't irritate my skin at all and helps my extra dry skin.

While I greatly enjoy the product, using the packaging is really irritating. After opening, if you try to close the lid a bunch of product sprays absolutly everywhere. The product itself works well, its light and hydrating and can probably be used by any skintype. Great cheap option, just needs a better lid.

I am 30, when i tried this i didnt notice at the time but it broke me out soooooo bad, face was always red. I only realized it was the toner bevause i decided to switch back to my regular toner to aleternate. And when i went back to it, immediately painful acne. It also smells terrible. Like chemicals but also smelled like rubber.
do have to wait 15 seconds to close it though or it will spurt out a bit of the product
Only con is it explodes rigtt he after you try fo close it. You have to wait a couple seconds beforsbyou close it, other than that i love it

avis.titre: I really wanted to like it
avis.texte: I've been using this toner for about two weeks. My skin feels like its burning and becomes really red, evertime i use it. It does leave your skin hydrated but if you have sensitive skin, its no bueno.

avis.titre: This is the best I've ever tried!
avis.texte: It's been the best toner I've ever tried. Seriously feels amazing on my skin. It's a staple in my routine!
Don't even question it. Just buy it. Trust me. Coming from a girl who's spent THOUSANDS on skincare- this is THE BEST.

avis.titre: Fantastic, will be a year round staple
avis.texte: I have sensitive, acne prone, combination skin. This makes my skin feel so hydrated and glowy, and also doesn't cause any irritation. Removing a star because I think they could improve their open/close mechanism, as mentioned in other reviews.

The bubble cosmic silk toner is the best rhode alternative the consistency is so identical and the smell too and l feel like ghe bubble one look a little better under makeup 10/10 the only thing i hate is the packaging because it squirts out proudut due to how the packaging was made

I love this product! I feel like it's very milky and cooling. It feels spectacular on the skin! Doesn't do much to fixing acne or anything like that, but it's so moisturizing and an amazing base for under your everyday makeup to use instead of primer.
I really like this. Once it soaks in my skin is SOOO soft. It feels like I had just put good moisturizer on. It gives my skin a slight glowy look and works nicely under my makeup.

I really enjoyed using this product. It feels so nice on the skin and gives it a nice glow, but after a couple of times using it though i brokeout. I stopped using it and then tried again and i woke up to three small pimples so i knew it was from this):

I wanted to love this product but after about a week when you attempt to get any product from the bottle and then go to close the bottle, an absurd amount of product spills out and you can't put it back, it's just wasted. absolutely horrible packaging

This product is a rich milky toner very similar if not the same as the rhode milky toner. I like the packaging on this a lot and think that it feels very chic. This product is more hydrating than the byoma milky toner in my opinion
Love it - glides on smoothly, feels cooling and leaves no sticky residue. great skin prep prior to tint or foundation.
Omg I'm obsessed with this toner ✨ It leaves my skin looking beautiful, flawless, and glowing, and my makeup stays on for HOURS. Definitely a must in my skincare routin… Bought with my own $

I have never used toner because I have very sensitive skin so, I was worried trying this out. Its so hydrating and has transformed my skin!! My skin has never looked better, its so smooth and glowing. Def buying again 🫶🏼

avis.titre: Very hydrating but broke me out.
avis.texte: This toner was very hydrating and was nice for my skin, but I started getting really bad acne a week after using it. I do have sensitive, acne prone skin so that probably was part of the problem. As soon as I stopped using the toner, my skin stopped having super bad acne but it's still pretty bad after a month of not using it. It's very hydrating and nice, just not for acne prone skin.

I absolutely love this product, it keeps my skin glowy and moisturized all day. I especially love this in the winter time since my skin usually gets really dry and irritated with the cold. My only complaint is the mild smell of the toner. I am pretty sensitive to smell so things like that throw me off, but the product is so good so I'm overlooking the smell.

avis.titre: Great dupe but not for acne girlies
avis.texte: Identical to rhode, but broke me out! Rhode also breaks me out. Such a bummer because it makes the skin so glowy and hydrated:(

I love this milk toner. Its hydrating and leaves my skin soft. I do not like the packaging. The twisted top is annoying and needs improvement. After twisting the lid to close it, more product comes out of it and leaks. Definitely needs to be improved.

I used this for 2 days morning and night and got such terrible acne that I'm now self-conscious about. I had acne from a medication a few months ago and it made me self-conscious so I stopped the med and my face was finally pretty clear and I was feeling more confident but not now. Beware of using this especially if you have sensitive skin. Smh
I have been using this toner for the past couple of days now and I am amazed how much it has added to my skincare routine. I have sensitive skin and it is very calm and hydrating.

I love many of Bubble's products, and most have worked well for me, unlike this one. I really liked the colors of the packaging and how it felt on my skin, but the product inside was unnaturally white, unlike the picture. Another issue is that my acne flared up overnight after using this product. I checked online, and many of the ingredients could be potential acne triggers. Even though this product has a few downsides, it still felt very soothing and gave me a glass skin look in the end. For someone with more acne concerns and who is younger (I am 15), I would recommend the BYOMA hydrating milky toner—it's a more natural color, offers more quantity, is cheaper, and better suited for those with acne issues. Honestly, it still felt really good, so I might use this again when I'm older and my acne clears up. Still, a very good product
Hate the packaging, every time I try to open up dispenser the entire lid comes off - I even tried super gluing it shut. The actual toner is nice but jeeze its annoying

this is my first milky toner and I will definitely be making this a consistent part of my skincare routine. I have dryer skin and this made it feel more hydrated. It felt nice on my skin (not too thick or runny).

avis.titre: Love the product, bottle could be better
avis.texte: UNDERRATED PRODUCT! This happens to be my favorite milky toner even with acne prone skin My face feels great when i dont break out and still hydrates when i do experience a break out. Also love that it's affordable! I'd give 5 stars for better packaging and for them to make a bigger size!

I have wasted so much product becsuse of the horrible packaging. I also dropped it and part of the top broke off and it started squirting everywhere. If the packaging is ever fixed, i will repurchase this but until then, it seems like a waste.
This is the first toner I have tried that actually works on my skin and leaves a noticeable difference. I would definitely reccomend this product.

avis.titre: Changed the way my skin feels
avis.texte: I appreciate how hydrating this product is. In the midwest it gets so cold and my skin starts to get really tight and itchy. This has been a game changer and has added extra hydrstjon. Biggest con: took this on a plane and it exploded everywhere. Wouldnt recommend for traveling. I also actively forget to not twist the top after use and wait… I've wasted a lot of product because of this. It usually sits open because I won't remember to close it after waiting.

avis.titre: Love the product, NOT the packaging!
avis.texte: This is an excellent toner. I would love to purchase it again, but with the horrible packaging causing so much waste of the producf, it's not worth it!

avis.titre: Product is great, packaging is not
avis.texte: I loca the product! It feels great on my skin and is extrnelet hydrating. However, the packaging is terrible. So much product gets wasted bubbling out of the top. Maybe that's why the brand is bubble? I have to leave it open all day now to prevent product loss.

this smells so weird. It almost smells like rubber?? so if you're sensitive to scents, don't buy this. Also, the fact that you have to wait 15 seconds after using it in order to close it, is so inconvenient and annoying. i prefer prequel or any other brand tbh
amazing and cheap just wait to close the bottle for a few minutes so it doesn't explode

So i struggled with acne prone sensitive skin. I also have a little bit of rosacea in my cheek area and oily combination skin. I have been struggling to finally get clear glowy skin and this product is one of my go tos now in my routine! No breaks out ever and it hydrats my skin so well leaving such a great glow also under makeup it is game changer. I recommend this to everyone it is wonderful 🩷

avis.titre: Did not work for me, but might for you…
avis.texte: I wanted to love this toner, but within few tries I started to have little red bump out around my cheeks. Nowhere else. I stopped using it & went back to the BYOMA toner I had been using for months and the bumps were gone. Overall, I did like the consistency & hydration it provided. Skincare is very much case-to-case basis; what might not work out for me might work for others. It's definitely worth a try! For reference, I'm 32 years old, dry prone sensitive skin with no major skin concerns.

The product itself has a strange scent and is not very hydrating, my skin feels tighter than without it. The bottle is HORRID! If you miss the one tiny sticker letting you know that you can't close it right away, you will waste so much product.

I dont ever want to go without this stuff. I love it. My foundation looks amazing on my skin for the first time ever and i swear its because this toner makes my skin so hydrated and smooth. I will for sure repurchase! One note: i have never had any issues with the bottle being messy. In fact, i really like the packaging. Just wait 10-15 seconds after using, then slowly twist the cap down (as the bottle says to do). I dont know if they added those instructions to the bottle recently because people were having issues, but it really works!
I didnt believe in toners but this is so lovely and makes my skin feel wonderful, mositurized, and smooth. I think im about to be super loyal to this product.

I took a chance on this, as I do not usually use toner. This does not sting like normal toner, is hydrating, and I can tell a positive difference in my skin within a few days. However, I do not like the bottle, and I have lost a lot of good product due to the design.

avis.titre: Like the product but the packaging....
avis.texte: This toner is great and as a product it does what it promises. BUT the packaging is putting me off from wanting to purchase this again. I feel like I wait the recommended time and it still spills out. Bubble PLEASE fix this!

I decided to stray from my holy grail toner... I should not have. Pros this is somewhat hydrating. Cons the packaging is horrible. Says you need to wait 15 seconds before closing it. It shoots up and a ton of product is wasted. They need to stop trying to be so extra with packaging all the time.
My fave toner so comparable to the rhode milky toner .. but def more budget friendly . Leaves my skin so soft and moisturized
I love the packaging of this, so easy to open and close. This is lightly hydrating, I'm glad it's not overly hydrating because I use other things on my face

The only reason I'm giving this product 4 stars instead of 5 is because if I use normal amount, it will cause little breakouts on my face. I've learned that using about 4 drops is the perfect amount for me. Leaves my skin looking silky and glowy!

This could rival the high end toners. If somebody would've put it in your hand and you didn't know it was not of prestige quality. You would definitely think it was. It is my favorite "drugstore" Milkey toner. It's in my top three favorite toners of all. And I have tried over 10 don't hesitate to purchase. It is awesome even for mature skin.

I was so excited about this product due to all of the launch hype, only to find out it contains Xylitol which is EXTREMELY toxic to pets. This could have easily been replaced with a different hydrating ingredient. Not worth the risk of killing your pet by subconciously touching your face then touching them/their things or laying in a shared space, like on the couch, then posisoning them.

avis.titre: glassy skin but broke me out
avis.texte: i absolutely loved the way my skin would look and feel after using this, but unfortunately it made my acne so much worse after a month and had to stop using it 😭

This is an amazing milky toner! It is a great substitution for the Rhode glazing milk. This is even better becasue the packaging is so fun and innovative. I love everything about this product. It is hydrating and easy to apply to the skin. I have recommended it to everyone I know!
This is soooo similar to the Rhode Glazing Milk. It's super hydrating but isn't sticky when it dries down.

I purchased based on others recomendation, but I broke out with new acne almost immediately after trying. "Coconut Alkines" which is pretty high on the ingredient list, is a known pore clogging ingredient. Sad because now I dont know what to do with the rest of the bottle. Waste of money.
This toner is so gentle on the skin and leavss your skin deeply hydrated and glowing!! I can't go without this under my makeup This is better than the Rhode Glazing milk imo

ive been trying this toner out under makeup for the past month, and i'm absolutely obsessed with it! it's thick, hydrating, moisturizing, and pairs well with every foundation, skin tint, and moisturizer i've used on top of it. the milky consistency allows it to be as thick as it is while still absorbing rather quickly into the skin (i still use a fan to speed it up though). it's quickly replaced the ilia base face milk in my routine, and i'll 100% be repurchasing it once i've finished this bottle. the only thing that i don't like about the toner is the scent. i think it's supposed to be fragrance free, but it has a strange smell to it that i don't really know how to explain. it goes away when you start rubbing it into the skin. it's just when you initially dispense it.

I really like the actual toner. Its very moisturizing without being greasy. Works well under makeup. However- the packaging is horrible. Everytime I twist the bottle top to close it, a large amount of product squirts out. It makes a mess and wastes a ton of product— about three times what I would actually use on my face. Very disappointed.

This toner is so good for the summer! I am combo-oily and using this toner and then a sunscreen has been a game changer. It doesn't feel heavy or thick and my skin feels good throughout the day. My only con about the product is the packaging. If you don't wait a couple of seconds before closing the tube, it just squirts out.

I loved the texture of the toner and how it felt on my skin, but sadly it made me break out! Bubble reached out and recommend giving it 4 weeks as it may be purging, but ain't nobody got time for that.

avis.titre: Don't fall for the positive reviews
avis.texte: I wish i had read more indepth on this product and not been influenced by their paid partners on social media because i thought hey why not? Seems like a nice product and my skin is dry. Huge, huge HUGE MISTAKE. It worked lovely for about two days then gave me the nastiest break out ive ever had in my LIFE. I have sensitive skin and saw people raving and thought to take a chance and try something new. I wish i never did. I wish i could post the pictures in this review of my skin. I'd get a pimple or two along my forhead or chin every so often but not nearly my entire face in what looks like cystic acne. It hurts and im extremly self concious about it…. All this mess from this one product..

avis.titre: Bubble milky toner: sold out? NO
avis.texte: I love this toner from it's box to the product! It's lightweight, doesn't have a strong smell, and is easy to use

avis.titre: works but maybe not for sensitive skin
avis.texte: i really really really wanted to love this product bc it left my skin soooooo silky smooth but after a week of using, i had the worst breakout i've ever had on my forehead and chin.
Hydrating!! Your skin will thank you . I noticed a major difference immediately.
I like this and how thick it is. I have oily skin but dry. This has helped greatly
This goes on so smooth and absorbs so quickly and nicely. Leaves my skin feeling amazing and moisturized.

Idk what it is about Bubble's products but I have sensitive dry skin and everything I have tried from them has irritated my skin including this new toner. I gave it 1 extra star since it felt hydrating but it severely burned my skin.
